verdict.rationale: Mistral documents an Agents API whose agents autonomously execute tasks with built-in tools (web search, code interpreter, document library, image generation), plus handoffs for task delegation between agents. However, this is a developer-built capability rather than a documented assistant inside the product. A built-in assistant (Le Chat) appears only in passing community mentions of using OCR there, not as documented task delegation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a built-in end-user assistant (Le Chat) and its task-delegation features, and independent hands-on evidence of delegating tasks to it.
